messages.body_plain:
Hola Bruna y Camila

Apologies for the late response. I worked on a small update this weekend which I submitted to CRAN. It should be available again anytime this week.

In the meantime try this:
install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("clquezada/tRophicPosition", build_vignettes = TRUE)
Please let me know if you have any questions.

Best wishes

Claudio

--
Dr Claudio Quezada-Romegialli
Universidad de Tarapacá
